tasks.answer: Use ConfirmationDialog from the ui/dialog barrel (confirmation-dialog/confirmation-dialog.tsx). It requires triggerButton and confirmButton (React elements) plus a title; body, cancelButtonText, icon ('danger'|'info') and isDone are optional. DeleteDiscussion composes it with icon="danger", title="Delete Discussion", a destructive trigger Button and a confirm Button that calls the delete mutation.

LoginForm uses the shared Input from @/components/ui/form inside Form. Binding is via react-hook-form: Form renders children with its useForm methods, and each Input receives registration={register('email')} / register('password'), which Input spreads onto the native <input> ({...registration}) while label/error go through FieldWrapper. registration (Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>) is the only required prop; label, error and normal input attributes are optional.

DiscussionsList passes a pagination object (totalPages, currentPage, rootUrl) to the Table component, which renders TablePagination. TablePagination is exported from components/ui/table/pagination.tsx (not re-exported by the @/components/ui/table barrel, whose index only exports ./table) and requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl; it builds hrefs as `${rootUrl}?page=N`.

MDPreview renders the Markdown body: it parses `value` with marked and sanitizes the HTML with DOMPurify before dangerouslySetInnerHTML. It takes a single required prop, value: string (defaults to ''), used by DiscussionView and CommentsList as <MDPreview value={discussion.body} />.

CreateDiscussion is a no-prop FormDrawer form (title Input + body Textarea) whose trigger is wrapped in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}>; only ADMIN users (lib/authorization ROLES.ADMIN = 'ADMIN') can see/use it, so it must render inside the authenticated app route with the Authorization/user provider.

notes: No catalog CLI/JSON used. Shell search commands: (1) ls src + ls src/components; (2) ls src/features; (3) ls -la components/ui, components/errors, ls -R features/{discussions,comments,auth}; (4) wc -c features/discussions/components/*.tsx features/auth/components/*.tsx features/comments/components/*.tsx components/ui/{form,md-preview,table,dialog}/*; (5) cat dialog/index.ts, dialog/confirmation-dialog/index.ts, form/index.ts, table/index.ts, md-preview/index.ts, md-preview/md-preview.tsx; (6) sed -n '150,205p' table.tsx + rg attempt (rg not installed, exit 127); (7) grep -rn TablePagination --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts . ; (8) sed -n '200,249p' table.tsx; (9) cat field-wrapper.tsx + cat discussion-view.tsx + grep -rn MDPreview; (10) sed -n '1,80p' lib/authorization.tsx + sed -n '1,40p' api/create-discussion.ts; (11) wc -c/-l authorization.tsx api/create-discussion.ts + sed -n '80,120p' authorization.tsx; (12) grep -rn 'export const Input' + grep -rn "from '@/components/ui/form'". Scoped strictly to apps/react-vite to avoid sibling-app duplicates; confirmed Input is exported only once in that app and TablePagination is not re-exported from the table barrel (table.tsx only re-exports low-level primitives), hence the explicit /pagination import path.
